PARAMS = {
    "gmid_p": (7.0, 4.0, 12.0),
    "Lp":     (0.15, 0.15, 0.4),
    "Lea":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmid_i": (22.0, 14.0, 26.0),
    "It0":    (8e-6, 4e-6, 14e-6),
    "Ic0":    (1.5e-6, 0.8e-6, 4e-6),
    "Cc":     (7e-12, 2e-12, 15e-12),
    "Ks":     (200.0, 80.0, 400.0),
    "kf":     (1.6, 1.2, 3.0),
    "Idiv":   (1.5e-6, 1e-6, 4e-6),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VIN = 1.8
    vref = spec.get("vref", 0.6); vo = spec.get("vout_target", 1.2)
    Imax = spec.get("iload_max", 5e-3); Imin = spec.get("iload_min", 50e-6)
    CL = spec.get("cl", 1e-9); Iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It0, Ic0, Cc, Ks, kf, Idiv = p["It0"], p["Ic0"], p["Cc"], p["Ks"], p["kf"], p["Idiv"]

    def solve_vgs(dev, W, L, Id, vds, vsb=0.0):
        lo, hi = 0.05, 1.8
        for _ in range(45):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            if abs(lut.op(dev, W, L, mid, vds, vsb)["Id"]) < Id:
                lo = mid
            else:
                hi = mid
        v = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        return v, lut.op(dev, W, L, v, vds, vsb)

    # ---------------- bias ----------------
    Ipb, Ibc = 1.5e-6, 1.0e-6
    xt = 0.3                                   # folding-node target voltage
    mb0 = lut.size("n", 14, 2.0, Iref, vds=0.6)
    mb0 = lut.size("n", 14, 2.0, Iref, vds=mb0.vgs)
    mb1 = lut.size("n", 14, 2.0, Ipb, vds=0.7)
    mpd = lut.size("p", 14, 1.0, Ipb, vds=0.9)
    mpd = lut.size("p", 14, 1.0, Ipb, vds=mpd.vgs)

    # ---------------- pass + sense ----------------
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], Imax, vds=VIN - vo)
    Is_max = Imax / Ks
    ms = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], Is_max, vds=VIN - vo)
    Ip_l = Imin + Idiv
    Is_l = Ip_l / Ks
    Ip_h = Imax + Idiv
    Is_h = Ip_h / Ks

    # ---------------- diff pair (PMOS, bulk=source) ----------------
    I1_l = 0.5 * (It0 + Is_l)
    mi = lut.size("p", p["gmid_i"], p["Lea"], I1_l, vds=1.1)
    vt_l = vref + mi.vgs
    mt = lut.size("p", 14, 1.0, It0, vds=max(VIN - vt_l, 0.1))
    I1_h = 0.5 * (It0 + Is_h)
    vsg_ih, oih = solve_vgs("p", mi.W, mi.L, I1_h, 1.0)
    vt_h = vref + vsg_ih

    # ---------------- folding sinks, cascodes, load ----------------
    If0 = 0.5 * It0 + Ic0
    mf = lut.size("n", 14, 2.0, If0, vds=xt)
    msd = lut.size("n", 18, 1.0, Is_max, vds=0.6)
    msd = lut.size("n", 18, 1.0, Is_max, vds=msd.vgs)
    mfa = lut.size("n", 18, 1.0, 0.5 * kf * Is_max, vds=xt)
    Ic_l = Ic0 + 0.5 * (kf - 1.0) * Is_l
    Ic_h = Ic0 + 0.5 * (kf - 1.0) * Is_h
    mc = lut.size("n", 18, 0.5, Ic0, vds=0.45, vsb=xt)
    mbc = lut.size("n", 18, 0.5, Ibc, vds=0.6, vsb=xt)
    mbc = lut.size("n", 18, 0.5, Ibc, vds=mbc.vgs, vsb=xt)
    vbc = xt + mbc.vgs
    mpc = lut.size("p", 14, 1.0, Ibc, vds=max(VIN - vbc, 0.2))
    ml = lut.size("p", 12, 1.0, Ic0, vds=0.9)
    ml = lut.size("p", 12, 1.0, Ic0, vds=ml.vgs)

    # ---------------- netlist ----------------
    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("MB1", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb1)
    n.dev("MPD", "pb", "pb", "vin", "vin", mpd)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "pb", "vin", "vin", mt)
    n.dev("MPC", "vbc", "pb", "vin", "vin", mpc)
    n.dev("MBC", "vbc", "vbc", "rbc", "vss", mbc)
    n.R("RBC", "rbc", "vss", xt / Ibc)
    n.dev("M1", "x1", "fb", "tail", "tail", mi)
    n.dev("M2", "x2", "vref", "tail", "tail", mi)
    n.dev("MF1", "x1", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mf)
    n.dev("MF2", "x2", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mf)
    n.dev("MFA1", "x1", "sn", "vss", "vss", mfa)
    n.dev("MFA2", "x2", "sn", "vss", "vss", mfa)
    n.dev("MC1", "y1", "vbc", "x1", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("MC2", "g", "vbc", "x2", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("M3", "y1", "y1", "vin", "vin", ml)
    n.dev("M4", "g", "y1", "vin", "vin", ml)
    mpm = max(1, min(200, int(math.ceil(mp.W / 40.0))))
    n.dev("MP", "vout", "g", "vin", "vin", mp, m=mpm)
    n.dev("MS", "tail", "g", "vin", "vin", ms)
    n.dev("MS2", "sn", "g", "vin", "vin", ms)
    n.dev("MSD", "sn", "sn", "vss", "vss", msd)
    n.C("CC", "vout", "x2", Cc)
    R2 = vref / Idiv
    R1 = R2 * (vo / vref - 1.0)
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", R1)
    n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", R2)

    # ---------------- predictions ----------------
    beta = vref / vo
    Gdiv = 1.0 / (R1 + R2)
    vsg_l, opl = solve_vgs("p", mp.W, mp.L, Ip_l, VIN - vo)
    vsg_h, oph = solve_vgs("p", mp.W, mp.L, Ip_h, VIN - vo)
    gm_pl, gds_pl = abs(opl["gm"]), abs(opl["gds"])
    gm_ph, gds_ph = abs(oph["gm"]), abs(oph["gds"])

    gm1_l, gds1_l = mi.gm, mi.gds
    gm1_h, gds1_h = abs(oih["gm"]), abs(oih["gds"])
    gc_l = mc.gm * Ic_l / Ic0; gc_h = mc.gm * Ic_h / Ic0
    gdc_l = mc.gds * Ic_l / Ic0; gdc_h = mc.gds * Ic_h / Ic0
    gl_l = ml.gds * Ic_l / Ic0; gl_h = ml.gds * Ic_h / Ic0
    rc_l = gdc_l * (mf.gds + gds1_l) / gc_l; rc_h = gdc_h * (mf.gds + gds1_h + mfa.gds) / gc_h
    A1_l = gm1_l / (gl_l + rc_l); A1_h = gm1_h / (gl_h + rc_h)
    Ap_l = gm_pl / (gds_pl + Gdiv); Ap_h = gm_ph / (gds_ph + Gdiv)
    T0_l = beta * A1_l * Ap_l; T0_h = beta * A1_h * Ap_h

    CG = abs(mp.cgg) + 2 * abs(ms.cgg) + abs(ml.cdd) + abs(mc.cdd) + 2 * abs(mp.cgd)
    ugf_l = beta * gm1_l / (2 * PI * Cc); ugf_h = beta * gm1_h / (2 * PI * Cc)
    p2_l = gm_pl * Cc / (CG * CL) / (2 * PI); p2_h = gm_ph * Cc / (CG * CL) / (2 * PI)
    pc_l = gc_l / (2 * PI * Cc); pc_h = gc_h / (2 * PI * Cc)
    pm_l = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugf_l / p2_l)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugf_l / pc_l))
    pm_h = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugf_h / p2_h)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugf_h / pc_h))

    def psrr(T0, ugf, gds):
        f = 1e3
        T1k = T0 / math.sqrt(1 + (f * T0 / ugf) ** 2)
        fol = gds / abs(complex(gds + Gdiv, 2 * PI * f * CL))
        return 20 * math.log10((1 + T1k) / fol)
    psrr_l = psrr(T0_l, ugf_l, gds_pl); psrr_h = psrr(T0_h, ugf_h, gds_ph)

    dVg = abs(vsg_h - vsg_l)
    A1_avg = math.sqrt(A1_l * A1_h)
    load_reg = dVg / (beta * A1_avg) / (Imax - Imin) + 0.1
    line_reg = max((gds_ph / (gds_ph + Gdiv)) / (1 + T0_h), (gds_pl / (gds_pl + Gdiv)) / (1 + T0_l))
    iq = Iref + Ipb + Ibc + It0 + 2 * Ic_l + Idiv + 2 * Is_l
    undershoot = dVg * CG / Cc + 0.03
    overshoot = dVg * CG / Cc + 0.03
    vout_err = 0.15 + 100 * (1.0 / max(T0_l, 1.0))

    return n, {
        "vout_err_pct": vout_err,
        "iq": iq,
        "undershoot": undershoot,
        "overshoot": overshoot,
        "line_reg": line_reg,
        "psrr_1k": min(psrr_l, psrr_h),
        "load_reg": load_reg,
        "ripple_settled": 0.002,
        "psrr_1k_heavy": psrr_h, "psrr_1k_light": psrr_l,
        "T0_light_db": db(T0_l), "T0_heavy_db": db(T0_h),
        "ugf_light": ugf_l, "ugf_heavy": ugf_h, "p2_light": p2_l, "pc_light": pc_l,
        "pm_light_deg": pm_l, "pm_heavy_deg": pm_h, "C_gate": CG, "W_pass": mp.W,
        "v_tail_l": vt_l, "v_tail_h": vt_h, "tail_vsd_h": VIN - vt_h, "vbc": vbc, "dVg": dVg,
    }
